sources.title: MRI report — right ankle
sources.transcript: MUSCULOSKELETAL IMAGING REPORT. Patient: Maya Okafor. Date of scan: 29 July 2025. Referring clinician: Dr S. Whitfield, GP. CLINICAL HISTORY: Persistent right ankle discomfort following previous inversion injury. FINDINGS: Mild signal alteration involving the anterior talofibular ligament. Small joint effusion. No acute fracture identified. IMPRESSION: Appearances consistent with chronic ligamentous change rather than acute injury. RECOMMENDATION: Clinical correlation advised. Referral for physiotherapy assessment recommended if symptoms persist.

sources.title: Physiotherapy assessment letter
sources.transcript: BRIDGEWATER PHYSIOTHERAPY CLINIC. RE: Maya Okafor. Assessment date: 14 August 2025. Dear Dr Whitfield, Thank you for referring Maya Okafor for physiotherapy assessment of chronic right ankle instability. Maya reports recurring swelling after walking and intermittent tightness after around fifteen minutes on their feet. On examination there is mild residual swelling and reduced proprioception on the right side compared to the left. PLAN: Home exercise programme focusing on peroneal strengthening and proprioception, to be reviewed in three weeks. Reviewed once on 2 September 2025 with some improvement reported. Attendance then lapsed. Yours sincerely, J. Okonkwo, Physiotherapist.

assertions.text: I've had recurring right ankle swelling since a previous inversion injury, confirmed on imaging in July 2025. Physiotherapy was arranged but contact lapsed after one review.

Imaging in July 2025 showed mild signal alteration in the ankle ligament with a small joint effusion and no fracture. A physiotherapy assessment in August 2025 found reduced proprioception on the right side.
Physiotherapy review on 2 September 2025 reported some improvement, but attendance lapsed after that visit.
The imaging report recommended physiotherapy assessment if symptoms persisted. Physiotherapy contact lapsed after a single review. Should physiotherapy be restarted, or is a fresh assessment needed?
A physiotherapy discharge summary or final assessment letter is not recorded after the review of 2 September 2025.
